releaseNotes: More than one bank account. Every payment method can now hold its own balance, so a second bank, a wallet or anything else you keep money in shows up separately on the Dashboard and adds into Total Assets
Methods that spend from an account - UPI from your bank, a card from a current account - can say so, and their spending comes off that account instead of being counted twice or not at all

Before this, only the names Bank, UPI and Cash counted towards your balances. Anything else was treated as spending but came off no balance at all, so your totals quietly drifted. Money on a payment method that no longer exists is now shown rather than ignored
Set each account's balance from Settings - Payment Methods. You enter what it holds today, same as before
Your opening balances move onto their accounts automatically on first launch, and your spreadsheet gains the two columns that carry them, so a reinstall can bring them back
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later. From 3.5.0 or earlier you must still uninstall first, after syncing
